choice.basis: The dashboard caption states 'darker color means higher true value' and the legend maps dark maroon to the high end (100) and pale yellow to the low end (20). The California (CA) polygon is filled with the darkest maroon on the map, corresponding to the highest incidence value. Tennessee (TN) is pale yellow (low) and Delaware (DE) is orange (medium), both lighter than CA. Therefore, CA is the highest-incidence state.
choice.option_label: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up
